title: Counter track reads its specified cell
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $\mathrm{body}$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For any base configuration of the loop host on input $x$, any control state, input position, flag, counter, and payload tapes, head positions $c$ and $p$, and output word, the symbol scanned on the counter track of the resulting controller frame is the value of the counter tape at $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{body}$ and $F$ are finite Turing machines over Booleans
A base configuration of the loop host on input $x$
A control state and valid input position
Flag, counter, and payload tape functions
replaced:
For every controller frame of the loop host with counter tape $f$ and counter head $h$,
the symbol scanned on the counter track of the frame is exactly $f(h)$.
